<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **26** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1f1a369b513e2880213cd27cd2cad1faec1239f9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a6efba46f3e1223b062a572104beed9fa36aec49` — the merge of head `d79d71aa78c8cb9def0e3ce8c6f82b9bceb73120` into base `1f1a369b513e2880213cd27cd2cad1faec1239f9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a6efba46f3e1223b062a572104beed9fa36aec49 && git checkout a6efba46f3e1223b062a572104beed9fa36aec49
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1f1a369b513e2880213cd27cd2cad1faec1239f9 d79d71aa78c8cb9def0e3ce8c6f82b9bceb73120 && git checkout -B drift-repro 1f1a369b513e2880213cd27cd2cad1faec1239f9 && git merge --no-ff d79d71aa78c8cb9def0e3ce8c6f82b9bceb73120

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1f1a369b513e2880213cd27cd2cad1faec1239f9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1f1a369b513e2880213cd27cd2cad1faec1239f9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d79d71aa78c8cb9def0e3ce8c6f82b9bceb73120`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/objectql/src/registry.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-uninstall.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-uninstall-refuse-before-mutate.test.ts + packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts, packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-uninstall-withdrawal.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.package-delete-refusal.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/metadata-facade.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-compatibility-api.ts, docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md (D3, Supersede table, Decided-here 3), docs/adr/0141-inter-app-dependency-declared-checked-before-install.md (D3)

Read: card #28408 body and its three comments (triage 6550835568, claim 6552498667, os-dev-report 6553094234); PR #28506 body, file list and `git diff origin/main...d79d71aa7` (merge base `ea74ebf93`, 5 files, +309/−14); the check-runs on the head, read at 2026-11-01T04:01Z: 22 `success`, 0 `failure`, 11 `in_progress` (Build Core, Test Core 1/8–8/8, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates), the rest skipped. The required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates` (every `check:*` gate, ADR-0087 registration and doc-authoring included), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Test UI` and `Live E2E UI` are green; `Build Core`, `Test Core` and `TypeScript Type Check` had not concluded at read time. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set, `SchemaRegistry.assertPackageUninstallable(id)`** (registry.ts:5693–5713): after the ADR-0029 extender walk it derives `customizationPackageId(id)` (spec/kernel, the N-08 helper, no local suffix) and refuses when `this.getPackage(pair.value)` is defined. Narrowing, declared, and right: `pair.ok` is false for a `.custom` id (`base_is_customization_package`) and for an id whose `BASE.custom` is no valid manifest id (`base_id_invalid`), so uninstalling the pair itself and an `@acme/crm`-shaped id ask nothing new. `getPackage` reads the package record whether enabled or disabled, so a disabled pair still blocks — "installed", as the card says. Right.
- **Doors that inherit it** — `unregisterObjectsByPackage(id)` without `force` (registry.ts:5733), `uninstallPackage(id)` (registry.ts:7081, the first mutating step, so a refusal removes nothing), the protocol's `deletePackage` (protocol-package-uninstall.ts:138–141, before the `sys_packages` delete), and so `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` (packages.ts:2720–2731: `deletePackage` throws, `errorFromThrown(e, 500)` reads the thrown `status` 409 via `resolveThrownHttpError`, thrown-http-error.ts:244–250 — the 409 answer the runtime test pins through a real `HttpDispatcher`). Each one refuses before mutating. Right. The protocol comment's correction from "500" to "the refusal's own 409" matches `resolveThrownHttpError`. Right.
- **No door it must NOT narrow is narrowed.** Every non-test caller of the non-forced verbs was read: `ObjectQL.unregisterObject(name, packageId)` (engine.ts:21550) reaches `unregisterObjectsByPackage(packageId)` only when a package id is passed, and every in-tree caller passes the name alone (protocol.ts:19207, :19347; protocol-object-owner.ts:98; metadata-facade.ts:281); `MetadataFacade.unregisterPackage` has no non-test caller; `ObjectQL.removePackage` passes `force: true` (engine-compatibility-api.ts:224). A base upgrade or hot re-install goes through `installPackage`, which overwrites the record in place (registry.ts:6935–6940) and never uninstalls, so the pair does not block an upgrade of its base — ADR-0146 D3 ("Upgrading the base never touches it") and ADR-0141 D3's deferred upgrade interception both hold. Right.
- **Public surface.** `PackageUninstallExtendedError` is unexported (consumers compare `code`); it gains a readonly `customizationPackageId: string | undefined` and an optional third constructor argument. `code` `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `status`/`httpStatus` 409, `name` unchanged; no new error code; the extender-only message is byte-identical to `main` (the three-branch template reproduces the old string exactly for `pairStep === undefined`). No spec export, no schema, no authorable key moves. Right.
- **The message.** Pair-only: "Delete the customization package "PAIR" first (to keep its customizations, export it before that: GET /api/v1/packages/PAIR/export), then uninstall "BASE" again: …"; both causes: one sentence naming the extenders and the pair, then both facts. The prescription leads, as the family's rule requires (a 4xx message can be truncated). Right. Observation, not a finding: a registry below the REST layer names a REST door in its prose — the card's Wanted 1 asks for exactly that door by path, so it is the card's choice.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28408-uninstall-refused-under-custom-pair.md`: `@objectstack/objectql: patch`, title `fix(objectql)!`, a `**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing` banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, exactly one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. The level follows the kind: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol narrowing ships `patch` with its BREAKING banner and disposition (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3). The body carries a remedy sentence and no FROM → TO rewrite, so `no-migration-prescription` is honest. `packages/metadata-protocol` moves in comments only and `packages/runtime` in a test only — neither publishes, so bumping `@objectstack/objectql` alone is right; `Check Changeset` and `Lint & Repo Gates` (ADR-0087 registration) are green. The PR body's `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` line matches the changeset's and the diff. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` on the os-dev-report — nothing to answer.
- **Acceptance note, the prescription wording.** The card reads "prescribes exporting it … or deleting it first"; the message says delete first and export before that. Answered: exporting alone does not unblock the uninstall, and the message names both the export door and the delete, so the card's two remedies are both in it. Accepted.
- **Class-a finding, `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId`** (os-dev-report 6553094234; PR Acceptance notes). Read in the live tree: `handleUninstall` (marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:2358–2470) removes the ledger entry first (`this.ledger.remove`, :2376) and only then withdraws through `registry.uninstallPackage` inside `withdrawFromRunningKernel` (:2578–2598), which catches the refusal and answers a failed `cleanups` outcome inside a 200. With the pair installed that door answers 200, drops the ledger entry, leaves the base registered until restart and strands the pair afterwards — ADR-0146 D3's "no half-removed base" does not hold there. **Judged a separate card, not a block on this PR**, for four reasons read in the code and the card, not in the PR body: (1) the ledger-first order is that door's own recorded decision (#21576: "Never before: an uninstall whose ledger write failed above leaves the package installed") and is pinned as declared behaviour for the ADR-0029 cause in `marketplace-install-local-uninstall-withdrawal.test.ts:248` — so the gap predates this card and belongs to every cause the predicate carries, not to the pair; reordering it reverses that decision and rewrites that pin, which is its own card's reasoning; (2) the card's Wanted 1 asks for the pair cause in the ONE predicate, and every door inside the card's lane and file surface (`packages/objectql`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/runtime`) refuses before mutating; `packages/cloud-connection` is outside both; (3) the card's Wanted 3 instructs the seat to measure the door that uninstalls a base and record what it finds instead of reordering gates — the dev measured on a real `SchemaRegistry` and recorded; (4) the dispatch said "stop on breach; explain in the report", which the dev did. **Escalated to the seat**: file it as its own card under epic #28236 (fix: ask `registry.assertPackageUninstallable` before `ledger.remove` in `handleUninstall` and answer its 409; re-pin the withdrawal test), and ⛔ do not record the epic's two-minute check 「卸载 HotCRM 被拒并点名 `hotcrm.custom`」 as met on a marketplace-installed HotCRM until that card lands — on that install path `DELETE /packages/:id` answers 422 first (right, Wanted 3) and the marketplace door answers 200, so no door yet says the sentence. This PR makes the sentence true at the registry, the protocol and `DELETE /packages/:id` for every base those doors uninstall.
- The card's "Not verified: whether some host removes a managed install by another path" is now verified: one does, named above.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`** — holds against the code it cites and the scenario. The pair is found by id alone through N-08's helper (spec/kernel/customization-package.ts:94–102), so an exported pair installed by hand and a pair the ensure door will build (N-13) are treated the same (Wanted 2); the check sits in the one predicate `unregisterObjectsByPackage` and `deletePackage` already ask, so the question asked ahead and the refusal raised cannot disagree; `uninstallPackage` mutates nothing before that call. Tried to break it: a `.custom` base, an invalid-id base, a sibling `.custom` (`hotcrmx.custom`), a non-pair dependent (`hotcrm.extras`), a disabled pair, `force`, and the base-upgrade path through `installPackage` — each answers as the card and ADR-0146 D3 / ADR-0141 D3 require. Decided-here item 3 of ADR-0146 (one 409, two causes, one envelope, same door) is implemented as written. No finding.
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts`** — the card's three named cases are pinned (pair present naming it with nothing mutated, also through `uninstallPackage`; pair absent and two non-pairs unchanged; both causes in one refusal), plus the pair-then-base control (the prescription is a real way out) and `force` not asking. The message pins are by prefix and by the export path, not a whole-string lock, so wording can move without the test lying. No finding.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-uninstall.ts`** — comments only; both claims checked: the pre-flight now carries the pair cause (it calls the same method), and the door's answer is 409 (`resolveThrownHttpError` reads `status`). The real pre-flight is pinned by `protocol.package-delete-refusal.test.ts` for the extender cause; the pair cause rides the same call. No finding.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-uninstall-refuse-before-mutate.test.ts`** — a real `SchemaRegistry` and a real `HttpDispatcher`; the `protocol` double now asks `registry.assertPackageUninstallable` before its store delete, as the real `deletePackage` does (read at protocol-package-uninstall.ts:138–141), and deletes only the base's rows. The 409 arm checks the stored rows, the registry entry (still disabled), the object, the on-disk disable record and the pair; the no-persisted-half arm meets the registry's own refusal; the control deletes the pair then the base; the `managed: true` arm puts `PKG` in the engine's `manifests` map, which `isWritablePackage` (package-writability.ts:77) reads as a booted code package, so the 422 answers first and `deleteRequests` stays empty (Wanted 3). No finding.
- **Dogfood.** The narrowing arm owes the full battery once on the final head; the dev reports it green at `d79d71aa7` under the verify lock, and the head's `Dogfood Regression Gate` check-run is `success`.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none on the diff. For the seat: file the install-local uninstall ordering as its own card (③) before the epic's two-minute check is recorded met.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jvz29v`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QUs3BtyH9zgxKzYrJiH18J`

**VERDICT: PASS**

ACCEPT · PR #28506 · Head-sha `d79d71aa78c8cb9def0e3ce8c6f82b9bceb73120` · 2026-11-01T04:12Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 卸载基础包（如 HotCRM）时，只要配对的 `hotcrm.custom` 还装着就拒绝。返回 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`，消息先给出路（先导出再删除 `hotcrm.custom`），再点名配对包；同时被扩展时一个拒绝列出两种原因。
- **为什么改：** 不拒的话，`hotcrm.custom` 里的全部定制会变成孤儿（ADR-0146 D3）。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄（`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`）：以前能成功的卸载现在被拒。沿用同一错误类、同一 409，没有新错误码；`deletePackage` 在删存储行之前就问，拒绝时什么都不动；卸载配对包本身、`force`、无配对的基础包不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `assertPackageUninstallable` 与 `PackageUninstallExtendedError`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts`（先构建 spec），9 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。另：marketplace 的 `install-local` 卸载门会先删账本再问拒绝，配对包在时仍回 200，已立卡 #28511，落地前史诗的两分钟验证在 marketplace 安装的 HotCRM 上不算达成。

席位意见：拒绝在唯一的判定里，各卸载门都先问后动；at-tier 契约评审 PASS；可合。

## 席位核对

- **Form:** 5 files, +309/-14. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28506`: NOT governed, 323 lines ≤ 3000, Tier S. Declaration of record: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `@objectstack/objectql` patch with a BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition. CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review on the narrowing face, PASS at this head (6553178211), by an at-tier reviewer the seat fed the `--brief-template` brief. `Skills-docs: none` holds: no file under `skills/**` teaches uninstalling a package.
- **Premise measured:** the registry, `uninstallPackage`, `deletePackage` and `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id` each refuse with nothing moved (new describe blocks in `registry-assert-package-uninstallable.test.ts` and `packages-uninstall-refuse-before-mutate.test.ts`). The read-only 422 still answers first for a booted code package (Wanted 3, pinned).
- **Gates (check-runs at the pinned head):** 48 runs: 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; mergeable, clean (Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard and Check Changeset success). The narrowing's full battery includes the Dogfood Regression Gate. Dev: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. `pnpm lint` 0.
- **Accepted deviations:** none on the diff. The class keeps its name `PackageUninstallExtendedError`, because ADR-0141 and ADR-0146 cite it as this family's anchor. The extender-only message is byte-identical to main.
- **Out of scope and where it goes:** `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` removes the ledger before the refusal, a gap shared with the ADR-0029 cause and recorded under #21576. Filed as #28511 (①, child of #28236, Blocked-by #28408). The epic's two-minute check is not recorded as met on a marketplace-installed HotCRM until it lands. Non-pair dependents stay deferred under ADR-0141 D3.
- **Landing clause:** Tier S ordinary queue landing. The seat flips ready and enables auto-merge through the relay, then confirms MERGED and closes out #28408.
